project_extensions.scope: Research provenance, reproducibility, and independent physical checks

acceptance_criteria: Signed NST one-point topologies and independent CW derivatives agree within scaled 1e-36 at 65 digits with two finite steps.
Independent two-field linear response confirms the signed doublet displacement.
A28, A29 and balanced A30 shared-source projections vanish within absolute 1e-55.
Separate signs of pole VEV and local loop-minimum displacement.
Byte-identical replay and actual locked standards and RCRPS v1.0.1 validation pass.
